# AOSP test signing key

These are the publicly distributed Android Open Source Project testkey files from
`platform/build/target/product/security/`. They are used by the fork's release workflow;
no personal signing key or GitHub signing secret is needed.

Certificate SHA-256: `a40da80a59d170caa950cf15c18c454d47a39b26989d8b640ecd745ba71bf5dc`.

Source: https://android.googlesource.com/platform/build/+/refs/tags/android-16.0.0_r1/target/product/security/
